reports.title: Vattel's Droit des gens and Wolff's Jus gentium: the order of reuse
reports.summary: Vattel follows Wolff chapter by chapter: rank correlation 0.93 over 2,117 rows. Where he leaves Wolff.

reports.title: Five findings on Vattel's Essai sur le fondement du droit naturel
reports.summary: Vattel's Cicero comes from the Barbeyrac page he attacks; the word-for-word Wolff stops at PPU § 266; Vattel reads Barbeyrac's voluntarism in the notes; Burlamaqui's answer to Barbeyrac is new in 1747; the 1773 note to Préliminaires § 6 reads like a digest of Burlamaqui.
